en.title: Team Formation
en.description:
In each round, choose the highest score from the union of the first k people and the last k people of the remaining sequence; when the windows overlap, each person counts only once. Ties go to the smallest original index. Remove the chosen person and add their score to the total, until team_size people have been chosen.

Semantics follow the original OAMaster problem. The input protocol and the limits marked "site supplement" were compiled by this site and do not mean that the original problem provides these limits.
en.input: n team_size k, with 1≤n≤2000 and 1≤team_size,k≤n; followed by n scores (−10⁹..10⁹). The ranges of n and the scores are site supplements.
en.output: Output the total score, using a 64-bit integer.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
